knowledge:
- key_parameters: spe=A SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment object containing the spatial transcriptomics count data and metadata ;; cluster_col=A character string specifying the column name in colData(spe) that contains the pre-annotated spatial clusters ;; sample_col=A character string specifying the column name in colData(spe) containing sample or batch IDs, required for multi-sample or DSP testing ;; condition_col=A character string specifying the column name in colData(spe) containing experimental condition/group labels, required for DSP testing ;; replicates=A logical value; set to TRUE in svg_test or individual_svg to enable joint multi-sample modeling ;; edgeR_y=A DGEList object containing pre-computed gene-level dispersion estimates (e.g., estimated_y from svg_test) passed to individual_svg to significantly speed up cluster-specific testing ;; test=A character string for dsp_test specifying the testing framework, either 'QLF' (quasi-likelihood F-tests, default, stronger error control) or 'LRT' (likelihood ratio tests, more sensitive) ;; design=A custom design matrix (e.g., created using splines) passed to dsp_test to model complex experimental designs or continuous covariates like time
- alternatives: BayesSpace=A Bioconductor package for Bayesian clustering of spatial transcriptomics data, recommended for generating spatial clusters if manual annotations are unavailable ;; stLearn=A Python-based package for spatial clustering using Louvain or k-means, also recommended for generating spatial clusters ;; Banksy=A method that unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation, recommended for multi-sample spatial clustering
- when_to_use: Use DESpace when you have spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., 10x Genomics Visium, Stereo-seq) and want to identify genes with spatial expression patterns (SVGs) or genes whose spatial patterns differ across experimental conditions (DSPs). It is highly appropriate when you have pre-annotated spatial clusters (manual or algorithm-derived) and want a fast, robust, and statistically rigorous analysis using edgeR.
- pitfalls: Joint multi-sample spatial clustering (e.g., with BayesSpace or Banksy) is prone to failure or inaccurate results compared to individual sample clustering; if it fails, cluster samples individually and manually match cluster IDs across samples ;; Only genes detected above filtering thresholds in all samples will be analyzed in multi-sample SVG testing ;; Only spatial clusters identified in all samples will be analyzed in DSP testing ;; Joint modeling of both samples and sample-specific covariates (like batch effects) is not possible because they are nested; use one or the other in sample_col ;; Re-computing dispersion estimates in individual_svg (by leaving edgeR_y empty) is significantly slower than using pre-computed estimates from svg_test

workflows.name: spatial_variable_genes
workflows.intent: Identify spatially variable genes (SVGs) across tissue regions globally or within individual spatial clusters for single or multiple biological replicates.
input: spe_data.rds (SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment object containing raw counts, spatial coordinates, and spatial cluster annotations in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the spatial transcriptomics data and specify spatial coordinates and cluster columns ;; 2. Perform quality control filtering on spots/cells and genes ;; 3. Run gene-level SVG testing using svg_test() ;; 4. Run individual cluster SVG testing using individual_svg() to identify region-specific SVGs ;; 5. Combine and filter results using top_results() ;; 6. Visualize spatial expression of top SVGs using FeaturePlot()
workflows.code:
# --- Single Sample SVG Workflow ---
set.seed(123)
results <- svg_test(spe = spe3,
                        cluster_col = cluster_col, 
                        verbose = TRUE)

head(results$gene_results, 3)

class(results$estimated_y); class(results$glmLrt); class(results$glmFit)

(feature <- results$gene_results$gene_id[seq_len(3)])
FeaturePlot(spe3, feature, 
            coordinates = coordinates, 
            ncol = 3, title = TRUE)

FeaturePlot(spe3, feature, 
            coordinates = coordinates, 
            annotation_cluster = TRUE,
            cluster_col = cluster_col, 
            cluster = 'all', title = TRUE)

set.seed(123)
cluster_results <- individual_svg(spe3, 
                                    edgeR_y = results$estimated_y,
                                    cluster_col = cluster_col)

class(cluster_results)
names(cluster_results)

merge_res <- top_results(results$gene_results, cluster_results)
head(merge_res,3)
merge_res <- top_results(results$gene_results, cluster_results, 
                        select = "FDR")
head(merge_res,3)

results_WM <- top_results(cluster_results = cluster_results, 
                        cluster = "WM")
head(results_WM, 3)

results_WM_both <- top_results(cluster_results = cluster_results, 
                                cluster = "WM", 
                                high_low = "both")

head(results_WM_both$high_genes, 3)
head(results_WM_both$low_genes, 3)

feature <- rownames(results_WM_both$high_genes)[seq_len(3)]
FeaturePlot(spe3, feature, cluster_col = cluster_col, 
            coordinates = coordinates, cluster = 'WM', 
            legend_cluster = TRUE, annotation_cluster = TRUE, 
            linewidth = 0.6, title = TRUE)

# --- Multi-Sample SVG Workflow ---
set.seed(123)
multi_results <- svg_test(spe = spe.combined,
                                cluster_col = cluster_col,
                                sample_col = 'sample_id',
                                replicates = TRUE)

head(multi_results$gene_results,3)

set.seed(123)
cluster_results <- individual_svg(spe.combined, 
                                edgeR_y = multi_results$estimated_y,
                                replicates = TRUE, 
                                cluster_col = cluster_col)

# --- SVG Workflow with Batch Correction ---
spe.combined$batch_id = ifelse(spe.combined$sample_id == "151507", "batch_1", "batch_2")
batch_results <- svg_test(spe = spe.combined,
                                cluster_col = cluster_col,
                                sample_col = 'batch_id',
                                replicates = TRUE)

workflows.name: differential_spatial_patterns
workflows.intent: Identify genes with differential spatial expression patterns (DSPs) across multiple experimental conditions or time points.
input: spe_multi_cond.rds (SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment object containing raw counts, spatial coordinates, spatial cluster annotations, sample IDs, and condition labels in colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the multi-sample, multi-condition spatial transcriptomics data ;; 2. Run gene-level DSP testing using dsp_test() ;; 3. Run individual cluster DSP testing using individual_dsp() ;; 4. (Optional) Create a custom design matrix using natural splines to model continuous time trends and run dsp_test() ;; 5. Visualize spatial expression and predicted abundance trends using FeaturePlot() and ggplot2
workflows.code:
# --- Standard DSP Workflow ---
results <- dsp_test(spe = spe,
                    cluster_col = spatial_cluster,
                    sample_col = sample_col,
                    condition_col = condition_col,
                    test = 'QLF',
                    verbose = TRUE)

head(results$gene_results, 2)

class(results$estimated_y)
class(results$glmQLFit)    # or results$glmFit  depending on test
class(results$glmQLFTest)  # or results$glmLRT  depending on test

cluster_results <- individual_dsp(spe,
                                  cluster_col = spatial_cluster,
                                  sample_col = sample_col,
                                  condition_col = condition_col)

class(cluster_results)
names(cluster_results)
cluster_results$`2` |> head(n = 4)

# --- DSP Workflow with Smooth Splines for Time Trends ---
metadata <- expand.grid(sample_id = levels(spe$sample_id),
                        cluster = levels(spe$Banksy_smooth)
                        ) |>
    mutate(
      day = as.numeric(sub("DPI.*", "", sample_id)),
      rep = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", sample_id)) 
      )

design_model <- model.matrix(~ cluster * ns(day, df = 2), 
                             data = metadata)
rownames(design_model) <- paste0(metadata$sample_id, "_",
                                 metadata$cluster)

results <- dsp_test(spe,
                    design = design_model,
                    cluster_col = spatial_cluster,
                    sample_col = sample_col,
                    condition_col = condition_col,
                    verbose = TRUE)

# --- Single-Cluster Spline DSP Workflow ---
new_cluster <- factor(ifelse(spe$Banksy_smooth %in% '2', '2', 'Other'))
metadata2 <- expand.grid(sample_id = levels(spe$sample_id),
                         cluster = levels(new_cluster)) |>
    mutate(
        day = as.numeric(sub("DPI.*", "", sample_id)),
        rep = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", sample_id)) 
      )

design_model2 <- model.matrix(~ cluster * ns(day, df = 2),
                              data = metadata2)
rownames(design_model2) <- paste0(metadata2$sample_id, "_",
                                  metadata2$cluster)

spe$cluster2 <- new_cluster
results2 <- dsp_test(spe,
                    design = design_model2,
                    cluster_col = "cluster2",
                    sample_col = sample_col,
                    condition_col = condition_col,
                    verbose = TRUE)

res_global2 <- results2$gene_results
table(res_global2$FDR <= 0.05)
